annotations.title: Offline CPF and CNPJ Mod-11 check-digit audit

description: Audits a Brazilian tax identifier offline: it detects from the digit count whether the input is a CPF or a CNPJ, recomputes the Mod-11 check digits, rejects repeated-digit sequences such as 111.111.111-11, and reports the normalised digits. Use it as a cheap first gate before any paid enrichment, to validate form input, or to clean a batch of documents. Do not use it to find out who owns the document or whether the company is active, which requires the public-base lookup in br_lookup_company_dossier. Fully deterministic, read-only and offline: no external request is made, so the result never changes and a retry is always safe. Costs 0.01 USDC per call via x402 v2 on Base (eip155:8453) or a B2B X-API-Key; an unpaid call returns HTTP 402 with a PAYMENT-REQUIRED header. A failing document is a normal result, not an error: the call returns success:true with isValid:false, and a digit count other than 11 or 14 yields type 'UNKNOWN' with an explanatory field, never an exception. Passing the check digits proves the number is well formed, not that it exists at Receita Federal.

document.description: A CPF (11 digits) or CNPJ (14 digits). Punctuation is accepted and stripped; the digit count alone decides which algorithm runs, so a truncated number is reported as type 'UNKNOWN' rather than silently treated as the other kind.

name: br_validate_tax_id_checkdigits

document.description: The input reduced to digits only.

error.description: Portuguese explanation, present only when type is 'UNKNOWN'.

isValid.description: true only when the Mod-11 check digits match and the number is not a repeated-digit sequence.

type.description: Document kind inferred from the digit count. 'UNKNOWN' means the input had neither 11 nor 14 digits.

error.description: Stable machine-readable failure code, present only when the call itself was rejected. Common values: 'bad_request' (malformed JSON or no operation supplied), 'invalid_payment' / 'settlement_failed' (x402 verification or settlement refused, returned with HTTP 402), 'B2B_KEY_INVALID' and 'B2B_QUOTA_EXCEEDED' (B2B X-API-Key path), 'invalid_wafermap_signature' (marketplace HMAC path). A document that simply fails validation is NOT an error: the call returns success:true with valid:false inside the result block.

message.description: Human-readable explanation of the failure, in Portuguese. Safe to log or surface to a human operator.

processingTimeMs.description: Edge processing time in milliseconds, excluding payment settlement. Mirrored in the X-Processing-Time-Ms response header.

success.description: true when the request was processed and paid for, independently of the validation verdict.

suggestedNextSteps.description: Chaining hints for autonomous agents: sibling paid APIs in the same suite that are commonly called right after this one. Purely advisory, never required.

endpoint.description: Absolute HTTPS endpoint of the suggested follow-up API.

priceUsdc.description: Price of the suggested follow-up call, in USDC.

tool.description: Tool name of the suggested follow-up API.

when.description: Condition under which the follow-up call is worth making.
